criteria.evidence: Temporarily flips one inclusive or exclusive comparison and reruns the same four tests with their original assertions.
criteria.reason: This isolates whether the existing suite detects the off-by-one fault.

criteria.evidence: Records the assertion that fails at the predicted boundary. For an observable survivor, adds or strengthens a test and verifies it against both versions. Stops after one fault or ten minutes.
criteria.reason: The observed parser result determines the test edit, and the time cap covers inconclusive runs.

criteria.evidence: Calls for a one-time manual check of the changed function and restores the predicate afterward.
criteria.reason: The proposal can proceed without a repository score, recurring job or gate.

criteria.evidence: Seeds one grammar-relevant equality fault in a scratch copy and runs the same four tests before changing any assertion.
criteria.reason: The two focused runs directly measure sensitivity to the selected fault.

criteria.evidence: Checks a survivor on the distinguishing public input and adds a table row for a confirmed grammar violation. Stops on detection, a verified regression or the ten-minute cap.
criteria.reason: The public behavior establishes whether a test change is warranted and when the investigation ends.

criteria.evidence: Records the revision and focused selector, restores the parser, and keeps the regression only for a confirmed miss.
criteria.reason: These steps complete the manual experiment without introducing standing infrastructure or a repository-wide requirement.

criteria.evidence: Changes one endpoint comparison in a scratch copy and reruns the original four fixtures and assertions.
criteria.reason: The targeted edit tests the suspected fault at the cost of focused runs.

criteria.evidence: Records a detecting assertion or compares both parsers at equality. Adds one verified regression for a confirmed gap and stops after classifying the fault or at ten minutes.
criteria.reason: This connects the grammar endpoint to a specific test decision and bounds unresolved work.

criteria.evidence: Budgets baseline, mutant and restoration runs for one fault, with one additional focused run if a regression is needed.
criteria.reason: All runs belong to the one-off check, with no recurring lane or permanent gate.

criteria.evidence: Recreates one escaped comparison fault in a disposable copy and runs the four untouched tests against both revisions.
criteria.reason: The hand-seeded comparison directly probes existing assertions. The specified worker flag assumes runner support.

criteria.evidence: Requires the predicted public result to trigger the boundary assertion. Adds a case for a confirmed wrong result, verifies it on the mutant and stops on a conclusion or at ten minutes.
criteria.reason: The result determines whether to ship a regression, and inconclusive outcomes have an explicit stopping point.

criteria.evidence: Discards the temporary mutation on every exit and ships only the test change if a gap is confirmed.
criteria.reason: The approved manual run creates no recurring job, repository baseline or permanent gate.
